name: A booking turned away
description: Ada asks for three seats at an event with two left. The request is refused before anything is priced, written or sent.

trigger.description: Ada confirms three seats for the Night Gig.

trace.description: The page asks for the seats the same way it would if they were there.

response.message: Sorry, only 2 left for Night Gig.

trace.description: The server that takes the request is not a block; all it does is hand it to the block that answers this operation.
How many seats are left is only known from the event, so this much happens whatever the answer turns out to be.
The event is there, with two seats left of the three Ada asked for.
The request is turned away with the number that is really left, and this is where the run ends: nothing is priced, nothing is written, nothing is queued.

detail.message: Sorry, only 2 left for Night Gig.

trace.description: Ada is told why, with the number she could still have.

detail.showing: Sorry, only 2 left for Night Gig.
